competitions.result: Fourth round — lost 3–2 at home to West Bromwich Albion.
Third round — lost 2–0 away to Leicester City.
Champions League runners-up — lost 3–1 to Real Madrid in Kyiv.

overview: Liverpool reached the Champions League final and finished fourth in the Premier League with 75 points. Mohamed Salah arrived from Roma and scored 44 goals in all competitions, including 32 in the league. Andy Robertson and Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain also joined in the summer, followed by Virgil van Dijk in January, when Philippe Coutinho left for Barcelona.

After progressing through qualifying and the group stage, Liverpool eliminated Porto, Manchester City and Roma to reach Kyiv. Real Madrid won the final 3–1: Salah went off injured, Sadio Mané equalised Karim Benzema’s opener, and Gareth Bale scored twice. Firmino and Mané finished the campaign with 27 and 20 goals respectively. At home, Leicester ended the League Cup campaign in the third round and West Bromwich Albion knocked Liverpool out of the FA Cup in the fourth round.
